doc.description:
AF_8_V2 Computer Vision Pipeline — AE4317 Autonomous Flight of MAVs (TU Delft)
Runs the full detection + control pipeline on the Bebop front camera: 1. Ground-edge detector — finds the green mat boundary (HSV + Hough) 2. Obstacle detector — fused optical-flow + Hough + colour columns, outputs up to 3 ranked flyable corridors 3. Gate detector — dual BGR/HSV blue-pillar tracker, outputs gate centre, approach angle and distance 4. Controller — NORMAL / GATELOCK state machine producing delta_yaw_rad and forward_vel each frame
When AF_8_V2_DRAW is enabled (default) all overlays are drawn back into the camera buffer so the GCS video stream shows annotations live.
Results are exposed as: extern volatile FrameResults frame_results; // detection extern volatile ControlOutput ctrl_output; // heading + velocity
Read these from your flight plan or guidance module: ControlOutput cmd = *((ControlOutput*)&ctrl_output); guidance_h_set_guided_heading_delta(cmd.delta_yaw_rad);

define.name: AF8_VISION_CAMERA
define.description: Video device to attach the pipeline to (front_camera or bottom_camera)

define.name: AF_8_V2_DRAW
define.description: Set to 1 to draw detection + controller overlays into the video stream, 0 to disable

define.name: AF8_K_YAW
define.description: Heading gain: radians of yaw change per 1% of frame-width heading error

define.name: AF8_V_GATE
define.description: Forward velocity in GATELOCK approach mode (m/s)

define.name: AF8_GATELOCK_TRIGGER
define.description: Consecutive GOOD-angle + unobstructed frames required to enter GATELOCK mode

define.name: AF8_GATELOCK_COAST
define.description: Frames to coast in GATELOCK after gate disappears (flying through gate)

define.name: AF8_GATE_MIN_FZ_WIDTH
define.description: Minimum flyzone width (px) for gate to be used as heading target
